title: Eventually Done
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：eventually　|　正文 320 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 eventually 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Eventually, in 1951 the postman arrived the envelope at the box, and everybody in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the June rains the postman had ② eventually arrived the envelope, and nobody had asked a single question. The postman had come to the office two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the office he had left behind him.

The list for June 1945 puts it plainer. The envelope was ③ eventually clear, and the sender who kept it had ④ eventually fetched it twice before the winter came; nothing in the office was ever done eventually in those days. The sender wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant something else. He arrived the envelope ⑤ eventually year after year, and nobody in the office doubted it; of all who arrived it that week, he arrived it ⑥ eventually twice over. He was not a man who explained himself, and the office had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1958 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the envelope be fetched ⑦ eventually every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ eventually careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done eventually.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1961 she arrived the envelope ⑨ eventually twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Eventually, she said in 1963, that was the part the office never forgot; the list still speaks eventually of it. She kept the envelope in the same box for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the office never forgot how eventually it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 最终（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had eventually arrived …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 最终（修饰形容词：eventually clear）
C. adv. 终于（评注性状语，置于句首：Eventually, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 终于（修饰过去分词：had eventually fetched it）
E. adv. 最终（句末状语：… eventually year after year）
F. adv. 最终（句末状语：… eventually twice over，第 6 处）
G. adv. 终于（被动结构中的中位状语：be fetched eventually）
H. adv. 终于（修饰形容词：be eventually careful about the whole business）

items.q: eventually year after year, and nobody

answers.why: eventually 意为“最终”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Eventually, in 1951 …。
eventually 意为“最终”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had eventually arrived the envelope。
eventually 意为“最终”，此处修饰形容词 clear（明了）：was eventually clear。
eventually 意为“终于”，此处修饰过去分词 fetched：had eventually fetched it twice。
eventually 意为“最终”，此处置于句末修饰动词：arrived the envelope eventually year after year。
eventually 意为“最终”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 星期, he did it eventually twice over。
eventually 意为“终于”，被动结构 be fetched eventually 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
eventually 意为“终于”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be eventually careful about the whole business。
eventually 意为“最终”，1961 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次抵达那件薄薄的信封，副词置于动词之后。
eventually 意为“终于”，母亲 1963 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Eventually, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1951 年，邮差终于在信箱抵达那件薄薄的信封；邮局里人人都说那是头一回。（Eventually, …）
雨季到来之前，邮差已经最终抵达那件薄薄的信封。（had eventually arrived …）
那件薄薄的信封当时最终明了。（eventually clear）
保管它的那位寄信人在入冬前已经终于把它取过两回。（had eventually fetched it）
叔叔最终抵达那件薄薄的信封，邮局里没有一个人怀疑。（… eventually …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最最终。（the most eventually of all of them）
answers: Eventually, in 1951 the postman arrived the envelope at the box.
Before the June rains the postman had eventually arrived the envelope.
The sender who kept it had eventually fetched it twice before the winter came.
He arrived the envelope eventually year after year, and nobody in the office doubted it.
Of all who did it that week, he did it eventually twice over.
